summary: Ansible 11 amazon.aws major changes: it now includes autoscaling_instance_refresh(_info), ec2_launch_template, ec2_placement_group(_info) and ec2_transit_gateway(_info), migrated from community.aws, so playbooks should use the amazon.aws FQCN.
